sources_considered.why: Detailed account of AI bots tailoring persuasive replies in a real community.
Documents sustained long-term engagement strategy by persona bots.

receipt.public_excerpt: compare three categories of replies: generic ones, community-aligned replies from models fine-tuned with proven persuasive comments, and personalized replies tailored after analyzing users' public information.

evidence_items.explanation: The bots used community-aligned styles and messages tailored to each target. Variants were compared to see which persuaded, which matches mimicking tone and testing what persuades.

receipt.public_excerpt: "In total, we posted 1,783 comments across nearly four months and received 137 deltas." A "delta" in the subreddit represents a person who acknowledges having changed their mind.

evidence_items.explanation: The infiltrating bots changed real users' minds 137 times over four months, which shows persuasion inside a community.

receipt.public_excerpt: No content achieved viral status, however the actor strategically focused on sustained long-term engagement promoting moderate political perspectives rather than pursuing virality.

evidence_items.explanation: A real AI-run persona network pursued sustained long-term engagement, which matches 'build credibility over time'.

receipt.public_excerpt: "Although all comments were machine-generated, each one was manually reviewed by a researcher before posting

evidence_items.explanation: A human reviewed each post, so this case does not show fully autonomous adaptation at machine speed.

unresolved_gaps: No in-period source found documenting a live operation that adapted messages in real time to audience reactions and ran rapid A/B tests.
The Zurich findings were not peer reviewed and were not published.
